svg.title: 17 round trips versus 1
svg.desc: Left: a model drives 17 tool calls one after another, a counter climbing to 17 round trips. Right: the same task as one Code Mode script sent to Mycel, which makes the 17 calls inside its sandbox, for 1 round trip. A client making one call per turn needs 17 turns; batch tools need about 3. Code Mode assumes a working script first time; not yet measured with a live model.
svg.text: DIRECT: the model drives every call
MYCEL: Code Mode runs the loop
Each arrow pair = one model turn.
17 calls fan out inside the sandbox.
Only the final result returns to the model.
"Find stale notes and save a report": 17 calls, 1 round trip (batch tools: ~3; not yet measured live) · overhead ~+0.4 ms Mac, +1 ms CI
